value.body: Secretarial executives support a company secretary or a practising CS firm with day-to-day company-law work: board and shareholder meetings, statutory registers, filings with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and, for listed companies, stock-exchange disclosures. Many are CS students or recently qualified CS members.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: CS Executive or Professional stage, often with a B.Com or LLB

items.label: Common tools
items.value: MCA21 portal, stock exchange filing portals, MS Word and Excel

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Many start during or after the ICSI practical training stage, at practising CS firms or in company secretarial teams. Accuracy in drafting and knowledge of filing timelines are what employers test.

value.title: At a glance
items: Work is deadline-driven around board meetings and filing dates.
Common next steps: qualify as a CS and move to company secretary or compliance officer.
Practising-firm roles give exposure to many companies at once.
